summary: Sanofi filed a 6-K announcing the pricing of €2.3 billion in notes across three tranches (€1,000M 3.000% due 2029; €650M 3.375% due 2033; €650M 3.750% due 2037) under its Euro Medium Term Note programme. Net proceeds are for general corporate purposes. The transaction was led by Citigroup, HSBC, and J.P. Morgan as global coordinators. This is a routine debt offering with no acquisition, divestiture, or other special-situation trigger. The filing is an ordinary financing event; no risk-arb angle or special-situation dynamics are present.
